site.aciklama: My Umrah Guide: a guide app by your side during Umrah, with prayers, the Holy Quran, prayer times, qibla, places to visit, an audio guide and family tracking.

silme.giris: You can delete your My Umrah Guide account and associated data at any time. This page explains how to delete in the app and how to request deletion if you cannot access the app.
silme.adim1: Open the My Umrah Guide app and sign in with your Google account.
silme.adim2: Go to the Profile tab in the bottom menu.
silme.adim3: Tap “Delete my account” at the bottom of the page.
silme.adim4: Choose “Delete permanently” in the confirmation dialog and verify again with your Google account.
silme.adim5: When you see “Your account has been deleted.”, the process is complete.
silme.acenteNot: If your account was created by an agency (PIN sign-in), send your deletion request to your agency or to us as described below.
silme.silinen2: Your profile details (name, email, phone, photo)
silme.silinen3: Group Khatm groups you created; you leave the groups you joined
silme.silinen4: Location records you shared and your trip details
silme.saklanan: Payment and invoice records are kept for the period required by law and then deleted. Your request is completed within 30 days at the latest.
silme.talepBaslik: If you cannot access the app
silme.talep: If you cannot sign in, send an email with the subject “Account deletion request” from the email address you use in the app to the address below. We will contact you from the same address to verify your identity.
silme.formYakinda: A web request form verified with Google will be available on this page soon.

destek.giris: Contact us with your questions, suggestions and issues about the app.
destek.ipucu1: If location, notifications or the microphone do not work, check Settings > Apps > My Umrah Guide > Permissions on your phone.
destek.ipucu2: For package and payment questions, include the payment date and the Google account you use in the app.
destek.ipucu3: To delete your account, see the Account deletion page.
